Team — attaching the Q3 heatmap export and a small ledger template. Finance asked for a cleaned view of commit/forecast by close date for Friday EOD so they can finalize the mid-quarter reforecast. Quick asks:  

- Please update stage and expected close date for every open deal you own in the heatmap (columns: deal_id, stage, owner, expected_close, confidence).
- Flag any deals that you want labeled RED/YELLOW/GREEN and add a one-liner rationale in the comments column.
- If a deal is stalled by procurement/security, mark "procurement" in the blocker column and note next cadence date.

Attached: q3_pipeline_heatmap.csv (exported from dashboard), commit-ledger-template.xlsx (simple ledger to paste rows into). I will consolidate into the ledger and send to Finance after your updates.

Notes: we only need the high-risk candidates for the reforecast — focus on deals with close dates in Sep–Oct and ARR > $50k.

Thanks,
Laura
